name: Laiba
wishText: Tumhari zindagi khushiyon se bhari ho, har din tumhare liye khaas ho. Allah tumhein hamesha khush rakhe aur tumhari har dua qubool ho. Stay blessed!
textInChatBox: Happy birthday to you!! Yeee! Bohat bohat mubarak ho Laiba!
text2: Maine socha tumhe kuch acha doon.
replayText: Agar pasand aaya toh dobara dekhna 😊
